qualifying.hardware_type: On-site fuel-gas-fired energy system at the Lumut plant (nine steam boilers, described by the operator as 'equivalent to a 300 MW power station') driving both mechanical-drive turbine-compressors and generator turbines; co-located 246 MWe Lumut Cogen Power Station, gas-fired, commissioned 1987, operated by Brunei LNG Sdn Bhd itself, supplies electricity and steam to the site.
qualifying.individual_mw: 246 MWe (Lumut Cogen Power Station, single gas-fired cogen plant, operator-owned)
qualifying.aggregate_mw: ~300 MW-equivalent for the boiler-driven energy system per the operator's own description, plus the separate 246 MWe cogen plant
qualifying.basis: Individual >=50 MW - the co-located 246 MWe Lumut Cogen Power Station, gas-fired and operated by Brunei LNG itself, individually clears the threshold many times over; the boiler-driven mechanical-drive/generator-turbine system (operator-described as 'equivalent to a 300 MW power station') also qualifies.

qualifying.aggregate_mw: 66.3 MW aggregate across gas-fired units (3x11.4+1x5.7 MW gensets = 39.9 MW, plus 2x13.2 MW turbo-generators = 26.4 MW; the 500 kW emergency diesel is excluded)

qualifying.hardware_type: Wison New Energies standard FLNG design: 2xLM6000PF+ aeroderivative gas turbines (with waste-heat recovery) mechanically drive the refrigerant compressors; 1xLM2500 aeroderivative turbine mechanically drives NGL-recovery booster compression; Solar Titan 130 aeroderivative gas turbine generators (with WHR) provide site power generation.

qualifying.aggregate_mw: ~90-100 MW aggregate across the 2xLM6000PF+ mechanical-drive turbines (aeroderivative rule)
qualifying.basis: Aggregate >=50 MW (aeroderivative rule, mechanical drive) - 2xLM6000PF+ aeroderivative gas turbines mechanically driving refrigerant compressors aggregate to an estimated 90-100 MW at the standard LM6000 class rating; class inferred from the named turbine model, no site-specific figure published (JUDGMENT CALL - class-rating inference).

qualifying.hardware_type: PFLNG DUA (moored offshore FLNG vessel): 4xGE PGT25+G4 aeroderivative gas turbine generator systems supply the facility's electric power; 2xLM6000-PF+ 2BCL907 aeroderivative gas turbines mechanically drive the nitrogen-liquefaction-train compressors. Both installed under GE Oil & Gas's November 2014 turbomachinery contract.
qualifying.individual_mw: ~45-50 MW each for the 2xLM6000-PF+ mechanical-drive units (LM6000 aeroderivative class rating per convention; no site-specific figure published); PGT25+G4 power-generation units' individual rating not specified in source.
qualifying.aggregate_mw: ~90-100 MW aggregate across the 2xLM6000-PF+ mechanical-drive turbines (aeroderivative rule); 4xPGT25+G4 power-generation turbines aggregate separately, MW not stated in source.

qualifying.hardware_type: 2xGE Frame 7EA heavy-duty gas turbines (mechanical drive), each paired with a 13 MW induction motor (VSI/VSD, 3,600 rpm) as a helper/assist unit, drive Train 9's LP/MP mixed-refrigerant and propane/HP mixed-refrigerant compression trains. The wider Bintulu Petronas LNG Complex also self-generates a portion of its electricity via on-site gas turbines.
qualifying.individual_mw: ~85-90 MW shaft each (GE Frame 7EA class rating; no site-specific figure published) for the mechanical-drive turbines; the paired 13 MW motor is a helper/assist unit driving alongside, not a separate qualifying generator.
qualifying.aggregate_mw: n/a (mechanical drive, heavy-duty individual-unit rule, not summed - combined class rating would be roughly 170-180 MW across both units)
qualifying.basis: Individual >=50 MW (mechanical drive; Frame 7EA class-rating inference, JUDGMENT CALL - class rating inferred from the named turbine model, no site-specific figure published).

qualifying.hardware_type: Purpose-built onshore gas-fired power plant at Sipitang (Sabah), adjacent to PFLNG Tiga's nearshore mooring: 7xMAN Energy Solutions 20V35/44G gas engines, described by both the equipment vendor and independent trade press as becoming the sole electricity supply to the terminal.

qualifying.basis: Aggregate >=50 MW (genset rule) - 7 gas engines totaling 70 MW, explicitly the sole electricity supply to the terminal; well above the 50 MW aggregate threshold.

qualifying.hardware_type: PFLNG SATU (moored at the Kanowit field, off-grid by construction): 4x GE PGT25+G4 gas turbine generator sets supply on-site electricity, plus 2x PGT25+G4 gas turbines in mechanical-drive service on the liquefaction compression trains (alongside 2 electric-motor-driven compressor modules).
qualifying.individual_mw: ~30-34 MW each (PGT25+G4 = industrial LM2500+G4; class rating, no site-specific figure published)
